purpose: The Languages group of a held person card: the languages by name and flag, add, flag, remove, mark the contact language, make private.
namedChanges: `LanguagesCard` and `LanguageSection` take the optional prop `renderCountrySearch` and hand it to `FlagChooser` (STOP-3; absent: no country search).

`LanguagesCard` shows an entry that is being read as "…", one that could not be read or has no name of its own as "A language" (`labelOf` becomes `nameOf`, using `language-row`'s `languageNameOf`), in place of the entry's label, which falls back to the last part of its address; the flag chooser is given the same name.
The imports come from the units; the header comments drop the notes of where the files were copied from.
